column_description: Identifier of the NuSEDS population referenced by this source record. It repeats across years and sometimes within one year.
Source population name. The official dictionary describes a legacy composite of stream name, subdistrict, species and run type; retain the full label without reparsing it into asserted facts.
NuSEDS subdistrict code. The official dictionary says subdistricts can differ from statistical areas, especially in the Fraser; do not relabel this field PFMA.
Source name of the waterbody or portion bounding the population as represented on the source estimate document (SEN). It need not be a unique waterbody identifier.
Year for which the estimate is reported. The official dictionary states that contributing surveys can continue into the next calendar year.
Source species designation for the fish represented by the record; all values in this selected slice are Coho.
Source run-type category. Preserve the supplied code or label; this slice contains 1, FALL and blanks.

Reported estimate for mature spawners excluding jacks, under the source field NATURAL_ADULT_SPAWNERS. The official definition does not establish a natural-origin restriction; preserve that question rather than asserting it.
Source label for the method used to derive the estimate. Interpret each label using its own definition; some entries in the official dictionary have no substantive definition.

Source category describing the estimate and its accuracy/precision classification. NO SURVEY THIS YEAR means the stream was not inspected for that species that year according to the official dictionary.
Source publication/readiness stage of the SEN estimate. All rows in this slice are FINAL; this source status does not approve our workshop interpretation or publication.
Date stream inspections began for this season's estimate, following the official dictionary. The derivation converts source dates to ISO representation.
Date stream inspections ended for this season's estimate, following the official dictionary. Keep separate from the estimate year.
Source hierarchical provincial watershed code. Preserve the complete text, separators and zeroes; the official dictionary distinguishes this legacy code from FWA_Watershed_CDE.
